headline: Iran Threatens to Stop Other Countries' Oil Exports If It Is Blocked
summary: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf warned that no country in the region would be able to sell oil if Iran is prevented from exporting. The warning was reported by Antara News.
why: Iran is a major oil producer, and threats to regional supply routes and exports are closely watched by crude oil traders and energy markets.
why_moved: A threat to halt regional oil exports if Iran is blocked raises concerns about crude supply, which typically lifts oil prices.
